notes.title: A Gigantic Update Appears!
notes.content:
Hi Super Sleuths!

We've been working away the past six months and I'm so excited to finally bring you...

[b]Jenny LeClue - Detectivu[/b]
[h1]SPOKEN SECRETS EDITION[/h1]

• Featuring voice acting for the entire game!!! 
• Play the game like an animated movie with new auto-play dialogue!
• Touch control improvements!
• Bug fixes galore!

We hope you enjoy! And if you find any issues, please don't hesitate to reach out to me at [url=mailto:support@mografi.com]support@mografi.com[/url]!

-Joe

[previewyoutube=Ob8n3wr8WFw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Indie Megabooth "Going Away" Sale! - Jenny LeClue is 25% from May 5-12!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12697154/9d6e024bed699fabed18df7ca85458b2b4caa342.jpg[/img]

Hello Super Sleuths!

1. Join Jenny LeClue in supporting Indie Megabooth’s Going Away Sale! Indie Megabooth has supported us and so many other indie devs over the years and we are offering Jenny LeClue at a 25% discount in their honor!

You can also directly [url=https://www.paypal.me/IndieMEGABOOTH]support then via PayPal[/url], for anyone who just wants to contribute to IMB directly. )

2. Our tiny team is hard at work on a huge update which will add full voice acting to Jenny LeClue. In addition there will be some polishes, bugfixes and the like. We are hoping to have it live some time next month... So now is a great time to pickup a copy or send a copy to your friend while the game is discounted until May 12th!

Until next time, happy detectiving!
-Joe

notes.title: Oh, and we added KEYBOARD REMAPPING!
notes.content:
In the last post I forgot to mention one of the big features we added...

[h1]KEYBOARD REMAPPING![/h1]

-Joe

notes.title: ACHIEVEMENTS & NEW GAME+ UNLOCKED!
notes.content:
Howdy fellow detectives!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12697154/f8e936b0b0f9849ad06ac3fdf5b0b2f954247a7c.jpg[/img]

[b]We've just released v1.0.13 with some major features![/b]

[list]
[*] [h1]Achievements*[/h1]
Achievements should retroactively unlock if you already have a save game

[*][h1]New Game+ & Scene Select[/h1]
Give you a chance to hop around and make different choices and pick up items you may have missed without starting from scratch!

[*][h1]Bug fixes & Polishes[/h1]
[/list]

Hope you enjoy, and look forward to some fun stuff coming up for Halloween! =]

-Joe



*Due to third-party software limitations, we aren't able to provide achievements in the win32 build of the game at this time, but it features all other updates.
